skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply public accounting principles and practices in administrative and public service units.
Analyze and evaluate financial statements and operations in administrative and public service units.
Develop critical thinking skills to evaluate accounting policies and practices in administrative and public service units.
Work independently and in teams to manage and report financial activities in administrative and public service units.
Understand and apply professional ethics and responsibilities in public accounting.
Effectively communicate financial information and analysis in both Vietnamese and English.
Solve financial and accounting problems in administrative and public service units.
Demonstrate leadership in managing financial resources and operations in administrative and public service units.
Adapt to changes in financial regulations and practices in administrative and public service units.
Manage time effectively to meet deadlines and complete financial tasks in administrative and public service units.
